missions.name: First Steps
missions.comment: Form a band, release a record and get on the Top 10
missions.intro:
You are in the lower reaches of the music industry, and there are few who believe you can manage a Top 10 hit, stacking the odds up against you completing the Rock Manager journey to fame and fortune found in the upper echelons of the music industry.
   Prove them wrong, get a Top 10 hit!
missions.success:
Well done! <¤Calbum.name> entered the Top 10 showing the biz your promise but the critics slate the band as a 'One hit wonder'.
   <¤CBand.name> are destined to be a flash-in-the-pan so drop them and move on to the next mission.
   In the right column you can see a summary of how much points you got in this mission.
missions.failure:
That didn't go too well. Perform and try to build up a following making your musicians more interesting to the labels and generating revenues for the band.
   Take recording seriously and use session musicians if your own artists fail you. Record a new song if the first one is a flop with the labels.

missions.name: A Family Affair
missions.comment: An offer from Global Records might spell success.
missions.intro:
Global Records entrust you to manage the Golander brothers, a talented duo destined for great heights. Your task is to make sure they don't break up.
   No easy task as they bicker to the point of fisty-cuffs and you have only ten weeks to appease the brothers and get them on stage to play the Global Aid Gala at the Colosseum and make as much money from them in the process.
   If you succeed expect more offers from Global. Failure is not an option.
missions.success:
You made it! Global Aid was a resounding success. The Colosseum was sold out and the TV-viewers donated millions to Global.
   <¤CSong.name> was one of the best performances of the show, despite the Golander brothers are relatively unknown. Global now know who to count on.
missions.failure:
How hard could it be? You were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months and you fail! Small wonder nobody believes in you as a manager. You can forget about the offer from Global, too.
   Try again and make sure the duo get on this time.

missions.name: Hey Princess
missions.comment: Sergey's daughter wants to be a star. Are you the right person for the job?
missions.intro:
A "business man and entrepreneur" called Sergey Spektor contacts you to manage his daughter Nadia. She has wanted to be a singer all her life and Sergey is offering $120.000 to make her a star.
   Nadia is uglier than sin and rumour has it that she has a voice to match.
   All Nadia asks for in life is to appear on TV, and your job is to make it happen.
missions.success: At last Nadia appeared on TV and Sergey is proud enough to offer you his "services" should you need "help" with anything – anything at all.
missions.failure:
Sergey's patience is through. You were given plenty of chances and still failed. Sergey does not accept failure.
   You have let him down and, worse, you have let his beloved daughter down. Sergey suggests you keep your head down.
   Try again, and give Nadia singing lessons next time.

missions.name: Metal to the Masses
missions.comment: Firewolf are raring for a comeback tour before retiring to live off of the proceeds.
missions.intro:
Fifteen years ago Firewolf were at the zenith of their career. They packed arenas and ruled the sales charts.
   Of late the band enjoys only very modest success but Firewolf are on the comeback trail and hire you to manage their final recording and farewell.
missions.success:
Well done! Firewolf's farewell tour was what dreams are made of and you took a band from yester-year to the youth of today.
   You are name dropped in awe throughout backstage areas the world over.
missions.failure:
Bitter and disappointed Firewolf sack you as manager.
   They invested savings on a grand sortie into the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but your incompetence means Firewolf will spend the rest of their lives as entertainers in third class strip joints.
   Try again making sure you have a successful album out before attempting a world tour.
objectives: Go on a World Tour (minimum three stops)

missions.name: Kind of Blue
missions.comment: Poor Nick Chesterton can't stand the pressure but returns to the fray like a duck to water.
missions.intro:
Your mission is to make as much money as possible out of the talents of Nick Chesterton whose debut album "So Much Pain, So Little Hope" was a unanimous favourite with the critics.
   The attention was too much for Nick, who fled the limelight. Now a few years have passed and Nick is ready for a comeback.
   With expectations high Nick may not make it so fleece him before he shuns the limelight and flees the biz.
missions.success:
So he gave up at last? Well, it was only a question of time before that would happen.
   Nick Chesterton is a double nature, as much as he hates attention he can't live without music.
   He'll be back again surely, but by then you'll be busy with bigger things. Anyway, you made some dough from this little adventure.
missions.failure:
Yeah? The set up was perfect. You had the press AND the public on your side. Everybody wanted a piece of Nick Chesterton.
   It should have been an easy stroll to the Rock 'n' Roll Hall of Fame, but you couldn't even handle that.
   Try again, and don't spend your money so quickly this time around.
objectives: Sell 30,000 Copies Before Nick Quits Pop

missions.name: The Space Cadets
missions.comment: Concept band or proper artists – can The Space Cadets make the leap?
missions.intro:
Take a band dressed up as astronauts receiving media attention for their gimmicky look with a chart hit with an over-produced song and turn them into a serious act.
   The Space Cadets actually count themselves as serious artists. All you need do now is convince the press the same.
missions.success:
A happy end for the Space Cadets who win the support of critics and the record buyers alike. Now they can forever release live albums and greatest hits compilations.
   Thanks to your efforts, they won't be needing you anymore.
missions.failure:
Having had no success trying to become respected artists, The Space Cadets have decided to give up. Now they'll return to their day jobs in various record shops.
   You may try again and make sure to do better this time. Remember the critics are more interested in musical progression then commercial success, so throw in lots of gizmo sound effects when recording.

missions.name: War on Rainbow
missions.comment: Drive the naïve music lovers out of business!
missions.intro:
The naïve music lovers of Rainbow Records have eluded Global for several years.
   So far Rainbow have refused to be purchased by Global (who already own the other labels in Rock City), but now Global see their chance.
   Rainbow have economic problems and must take their chances with an unproven artist to stay in business.
   Your mission is to sell an artist to Rainbow, record a disastrous song and bankrupt Rainbow's coffers so Global can take over the company.
missions.success: Splendid! The last threat to Global's control of music distribution is bankrupt.
missions.failure:
<¤Cband.name> sold thousands and G. Jerome Vonderbaldt is furious. You have given the naïve music lovers of Rainbow a lifeline.
   Global's cunning plan amounted to nothing and your career is in tatters. Try again making sure Rainbow are liquidated.

missions.name: The Perfect Song
missions.intro:
The Global president G. Jerome Vonderbaldt has a new task for you.
   Frustrated by not being able to control the whole music production process, Global have spent millions on research into consumer behaviour.
   The research has paid off as what Global call "The Perfect Song" – the song to end all songs.
   Global have put together a band and want you to manage "The Perfect Band." Conquer the world!
missions.success:
Perfect! Total Global Domination.
   The Perfect Song can be recorded and marketed over and over again endlessly. It's perfect and the audience will never grow tired of it.
   Thanks to your efforts, Global's music will be the only music. You are of course richly compensated and will never have to work again.
   You have earned a total of <formatInteger(¤CPlayer.getTotalPoints(#Mission09))> points.
   The game is over and Global thank you for your interest. The points in this last mission will not be counted towards your total score. Don't ask.
missions.failure:
Despite The Perfect Set Up and Global's research investments, you failed to turn The Perfect Song into a global hit.
   Due to your failure Global has ruined years of research and your career is in the balance.
   Restart and complete the mission successfully
objectives: Record and Promote the Perfect Song

missions.name: The Sky is the Limit
missions.comment: No orders, no objectives - just 100% ROCK!
missions.intro:
Yeah yeah, you made it. You have had your fifteen minutes of fame. What? Want more? Just can't get enough of that rock'n'roll lifestyle huh?!

Allright, here you go: a whole year of rock'n'roll! Go out there, get dirty and do whatever you feel like. Kick out the jam!
missions.success: Allright people, move on! There is nothing to see here. This party is over!
missions.failure: Ooops! Maybe you weren't made to live a life of rock'n'roll after all? You better go home to mummy now! Or do you want to give it another try?

cards.comment: Lol Golander is annoyed with a band called Mouthful of Mutton.\n\tYou think they make the same kind of music as Morning Glory, but Lol Golander says Mouthful is disgracing a great genre.\n\tGiven the chance Lol Golander says in an interview that Mouthful of Mutton play "music for old blind ladies with hearing aids."
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Clash with Mouthful of Mutton
cards.Caption: Lol Golander
cards.question: Lol Golander defames other band

cards.comment: Mouthful of Mutton's front man Billy Mutton is furious.\n\tHe says he'll make an album about <¤CBand.name> to show the world what wimps they are.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Mutton Replies
cards.question: Mouthful of Mutton are pissed

cards.comment: Billy Mutton says to Radio FM that he accepts the apology you made and that he regrets the foul words.\n\tAt the same time, he reminds listeners of his earlier career as a pro-wrestler and warns the public about crossing Mouthful of Mutton.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Billy Mutton Accepts Peace
cards.Caption: Billy Mutton
cards.question: Billy Mutton buries the hatchet

cards.comment: You tell City News that Billy Mutton's past as a pro-wrestler is "mumbo-jumbo," and that it's a stand-in posing half-naked with an executioner's mask on MoM's record cover, not Mutton himself.\n\tCity News takes the bait, giving the story a full page spread.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Billy Mutton Revealed
cards.Caption: Billy Mutton Revealed as Bluff!
cards.question: You defame Mutton

cards.comment: City News runs a full page article on the "Rock Battle"  the quarrel between <¤CBand.name> and Mouthful of Mutton.\n\tIt says that several <¤CBand.name> fans have been assaulted by MoM fans and that retailers consider banning your records.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Catch On
cards.Caption: Rock Battle  Read all about the fight!
cards.question: Mutton clash hits the papers

cards.comment: TV24 invite <¤CBand.name> and Mouthful of Mutton to a live broadcasted duel.\n\tThey want you to appear on a popular debate show called Today's Opinion and determine which band really rocks.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: TV Want You to Settle Things Live
cards.question: You in?

cards.comment: Billy Mutton gives a statement to City News saying, "If there were Olympic Games for wimps, <¤Cband.name> would win the gold with one arm tied behind their backs."\n\tHe says that since you don't dare settle things with Mouthful of Mutton on TV, you have forever lost your respect with the rock fans.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Mutton Names You Cowards
cards.Caption: Billy Mutton
cards.question: You spineless creep

cards.comment:
There is little doubt that <¤CBand.name> owns this city, after they won the Rock 'n' Roll duel on TV24's Today's Opinion.
	You creamed Mouthful of Mutton and the studio audience loved it.
	Now Mutton will keep his big mouth shut.
	Ironically, the Golander brothers seemed to enjoy each others company for a moment.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: <¤CBand.name> Rock the Best
cards.Caption: <¤CBand.name>
cards.question: <¤CBand.name> wins the day

cards.comment: Mouthful of Mutton humiliate you on TV24's broadcasted rock duel. <¤CBand.name> make horrible mistakes and look really scared.\n\tMouthful of Mutton frightened the living daylights out of the host with their distorted bass riffs, sending the audience into hysterics.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: Mutton Crushes <¤CBand.name>
cards.question: <¤CBand.name> got beat

cards.comment: After hours of 'creative argument' in the practice room, Lol hits Nelly over the head with a shoe, and walks out.\n\tNelly is ok, but he wants you to fire his brother from the band.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Brothers Fighting
cards.Caption: Fighting again
cards.question: If this is the way it's gonna be

cards.comment: When Nelly tapes Lol's mouth shut with duct tape, Lol loses his temper and tries to strangle his brother with a guitar string.\n\tFortunately, you manage to tear them apart before anybody is badly injured.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Brothers Fighting
cards.Caption: Fighting again
cards.question: Bit of a skirmish

cards.comment: Lol is playing with a lighter during practice and "accidentally" sets fire to his brother's brand new designer jeans.\n\tThe flame is quickly put out, but the jeans are ruined and you have to hold Nelly back to keep him from beating Lol's face (which would be fatal for the press photos).
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Brothers Fighting
cards.Caption: Fighting again
cards.question: Arsonist-Lol

cards.comment: Your attempt to change the band name absolutely infuriates the brothers.\n\tThey say if they can't be Morning Glory, they won't be anything at all.\n\tYou have no choice but to change it back.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Morning Glory Mad
cards.question: No name change

cards.comment:
The artists easily fight each other or get in a bad mood.
	One of your most important tasks is to make sure they're happy. Otherwise, they might quit the band or worse.
	Click a musician to find a list of actions. Try giving them different things, but remember they have a mind of their own. Don't just give them anything to make them happy.
	Don't worry, they will certainly let you know if they are unhappy.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Whip and Carrot

cards.comment: Global Records honcho G. Jerome Vonderbaldt calls you to a private meeting. He says that so far he has not read one word about the Golander brothers in the press, nor heard their songs on the radio. They should be on all shows, all of the time!\n\tVonderbaldt hopes you have a media plan, because failure is not an option according to Global corporate policy.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Global Marketing Meeting
cards.question: Don't disappoint him, OK?

cards.comment: You are called up to Global Records to receive a lecture from the company's furious president.\n\tYour primary goal is to keep the Golander brothers together, but the point of all business is to make money. So far you've sold less than Global's worst-selling artist ever: Eric Flanders.\n\tThat's a record you don't want to break.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Global Sales Meeting
cards.Caption: G Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Sell some records

cards.comment: Nelly Golander is furious that you would have Morning Glory play any other song than his masterpiece, "Supermarket Love."\n\tHe has spent years writing that song, a  true statement describing Morning Glory's stance.\n\tHe wants you to reconsider.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nelly's Feelings Hurt
cards.Caption: Sensitive type
cards.question: Nelly wants to do his own material

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is mad because you're giving his brother more gifts than you're giving him.\n\tHe thinks it's important for a manager to be fair to the artists and give them gifts in equal measures.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Treated Unjustly
cards.Caption: Sensitive type
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.name> wants more gifts

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is mad because you are training his brother more than you are training him.\n\tHe asks if you think it's important to train all band members.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Treated Unjustly
cards.Caption: Sensitive type
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.name> wants more training

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is disappointed with the record cover.\n\t<¤CRealMusician.Firstname> feels that {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]}'s not prominent enough on the cover, and wonders if you think {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]}'s less important than the others in the band.\n\tIf so, why not just fire {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Object:1]}?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Unhappy with Sleeve
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.name> hurts easily

cards.comment: Nelly Golander is concerned about the fighting. He didn't start making music just too pick fights with other bands.\n\tIf the fighting doesn't end soon Nelly Golander will leave the band.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nelly Golander Speaks His Mind
cards.Caption: Nelly Golander
cards.question: Nelly Golander is worried

cards.comment: How hard could it be?\n\tYou were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months, yet you still failed! No wonder no one thinks you're a competent manager.\n\tYou can forget about the offer from Global, too.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Lol and Nelly Split Up

cards.comment: How hard could it be?\n\tYou were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months, yet you still failed! No wonder no one thinks you're a competent manager.\n\tYou can forget about the offer from Global, too.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Lol and Nelly Split Up

cards.comment: Try again and make sure to get it right next time.\n\tGive them plenty of gifts to keep them happy, just make sure to give them equal amounts.\n\tAlso try gigs and holidays to keep their chins up.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You're out of cash? That's a joke, considering how much money Global threw at you!
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Out of Money

cards.comment: Next time, watch your expense account. Do a few gigs to earn some money.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You really think Global would let you sign their golden nugget to another label? You're fired and Global won't have anything to do with you.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Game Over

cards.comment: The Global Aid-gala will be held thirty days from today.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Thirty Days till Global Aid
cards.question: Thirty days and counting

cards.comment: The Global Aid-gala will be held ten days from today.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Ten Days till Global Aid
cards.question: Ten days and counting

cards.comment: This mission requires that you stay with Global Records. Start over and next time do not cancel the record contract!
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Radio FM play a song called "Cry My Eyes Out" by The Rockets. It sounds just like <¤CBand.name>'s <¤calbum.name>. It's almost like they stole your song!
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Copyright Infringement
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: Judge Griffin rules that "Cry My Eyes Out" by The Rockets has nothing in common with <¤calbum.name> and that your claims are unreasonable.\n\t"Anyone with ears can tell they're different melodies," he declares.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: The Rockets Win in Court
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin

cards.comment: Judge Griffin rules that The Rockets are guilty of song theft in the first degree.\n\tAll royalties ($30 000) from "Cry My Eyes Out" shall be paid to <¤CBand.name>.\n\tThe Rockets are sentenced to one month's conditional incarceration.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Victory in Court
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin

cards.comment: Sergey wants to know why Nadia's career is going nowhere.\n\tHe doesn't want to be rough with you, but he just might unless things start moving.\n\tNadia is going to be a star and be on TV, can you get it into your head?
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: A Warning from Sergey
cards.Caption: Sergey Spektor

cards.comment: You can train your artists to play their instruments or sing, do live concerts or interviews. You can also make them look and perform better through physical training.\n\tClick on a portrait to find a list of actions.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Train Artists

cards.comment: Sergey is furious that you would treat his daughter so poorly.\n\tShe's a princess, can't you see? How could you let her become so sad? No trouble should be allowed to put wrinkles on her beautiful skin!
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Worries for Nadia
cards.Caption: Nobody puts baby in a corner
cards.question: Nobody puts baby in a corner

cards.comment: Sergey is very happy that Nadia seems to be enjoying herself with her new career.\n\tYou better keep it like that, because daddy does not like to see his angel sad.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Happy for Nadia
cards.Caption: Keeping an eye on you
cards.question: Good, now keep her smiling

cards.comment: Sergey Spektor is very disappointed with the band's performance at the last show.\n\tIf the band can't perform a good show, then how is Sergey's beloved daughter ever going to be a star?\n\tYou're the manager so you sort it out!
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Unhappy with Concert
cards.Caption: Doesn't like a bad show
cards.question: Do better shows!

cards.comment: Sergey Spektor congratulates you on the great success of your latest concert.\n\tHe thinks you should keep doing shows like that, because if the band doesn't perform well on stage, how is Nadia ever going to be a star?
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Happy with Concert
cards.Caption: A pat on the back from this guy
cards.question: A pat on the back from this guy

cards.comment: In any business, doing nothing is a certain road to failure, Sergey explains as he criticizes your passivity.\n\tYou better take action or face the consequences.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Questions Your Strategy
cards.Caption: Perhaps Sergey should be running things himself?
cards.question: Get a move on!

cards.comment: Sergey is furious about the poor publicity. Don't you see? An artist needs good PR and lots of it!\n\tYou better start working the media, or else
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Unhappy with Media Attention
cards.Caption: Been around
cards.question: Do your thang!

cards.comment: Sergey is glad that the media is finally taking interest in his daughter's efforts. He holds you responsible for their continued attention.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Happy with Media Attention
cards.Caption: Hard but unjust
cards.question: Keep it up!

cards.comment: Your recklessness with Sergey's money has attracted his attention. He orders you to spend his funds wisely, or he'll have to take action.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Sergey Won't Tolerate Squandering
cards.Caption: Rich but cheap
cards.question: You big spender, you

cards.comment: <Missionvar.ScaredNewMusician.name> is worried about <¤Cband.name>'s connection to organised crime. {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<Missionvar.ScaredNewMusician.gender>]} doesn't want to get into trouble with the law and thinks about leaving the band.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Mob Ties Upset <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.Caption: Got the shakes
cards.question: Choose your friends with care

cards.comment: All <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name>'s talk about the Mafia offends Nadia. Nadia explains to {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.gender>, #Object:1]} that her father is a respected businessman who would rather die than engage in criminal activity.\n\tWhen <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.firstname> persists, Nadia responds with a physical retort, making matters worse.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Takes Offence
cards.Caption: Won't take any bull
cards.question: Nadia beats up <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name>

cards.comment: <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> doesn't show up for practice all day. It happens again the next morning and nobody seems to know why.\n\tAfter a few days, you get the awkward feeling that you have seen <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> for the last time.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> Gone
cards.question: <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> lost

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is very disappointed with the demo recording.\n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} thinks that Nadia's poor performance ruined a perfectly good demo. \n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} finds it hard to believe that <¤Cband.name> has a future with Nadia in it.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Distressed
cards.Caption: Disappointed
cards.question: Criticism against Nadia

cards.comment:
Nadia is furious that you would print a record cover without her on it.
	She's the star! All stars appear on their record covers! You just don't get it.
	Nadia won't work with you again ever and before she leaves, she warns you that her father won't be happy.
	Not happy at all.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Furious
cards.Caption: Quit
cards.question: You screwed up

cards.comment: TV24 are doing a big show called Stars of Cheese, sponsored by Mortensen Dairy, as promotion for their new Star Cheese spread (cheese with a chocolate taste for the younger generation).\n\tThey want <¤cband.name> to appear as the cheese-headliner. No pay, but it's a TV gig plus a lifetime's supply of Star Cheese.
cards.name: TV24
cards.Headline: TV24 Offer
cards.Caption: Say "cheese"!
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment:
The cheese gig was OK and Nadia is overjoyed. Now she is a star in her own right, being on TV was all she ever wanted.
	As a bonus, she made out with the producer in a broom closet after the show.
	Proud father Sergey Spektor pats you on the back and says it's a good thing you didn't screw up.
	You are always welcome to see him, should you ever need anything. Anything at all.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Nadia's Dream Came True
cards.question: Well done!

cards.comment: Nadia is very upset that you would give somebody else presents without giving her anything.\n\tDo you consider her less important than other band members?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Demands Present
cards.Caption: Giftless
cards.question: Nadia wants gifts too

cards.comment: Nadia is disappointed with you. You send other band members out of town, but she can't go?\n\tDon't you think she works as hard as the other members of the band?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Demands Trip
cards.Caption: Hard-working gal
cards.question: Nadia wants go away too

cards.comment: On a recent visit to the night club Mirror Ball, Nadia runs into Zer0 Magazine reporter Andy Fairlane. They get along really well, it seems.\n\tThe next day Nadia wears a turtle neck to practice and loves being in pop.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Snogs Reporter
cards.Caption: All butterflied up
cards.question: Nadia Starr in a good mood

cards.comment: Nadia is in an especially sour mood this morning and says she hates the whole pop-star deal. When asked what's bugging her, she at first won't tell.\n\tLater, she explains that she almost snogged TV24-reporter Steve at Mirror Ball last night, but some obnoxious fans got in the way and Steve split.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Misses out on Snog
cards.Caption: Love hurts
cards.question: Nadia Starr fed up with stardom

cards.comment: There's a big tumult in the practice room as Nadia is trying to claw <tmp.name>'s eyes out.\n\tAfter being separated, Nadia explains that <tmp.name> doesn't like her and thinks she has no talent.\n\tNadia also elaborates on <tmp.name>'s personal qualities and what she should have her father do to {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>]}.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Feels Misunderstood
cards.Caption: Hot-tempered
cards.question: Nadia at odds with band member

cards.comment: The show is unexpectedly good and the audience stays for the first few songs.\n\tApparently someone secretly disconnected Nadia's mike. She doesn't notice and no one tells her.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Surprisingly Succesful Show
cards.Caption: OK show
cards.question: Everybody happy

cards.comment: Just back from her absence, Nadia is anxious to set foot on stage and demands that you find her a gig right away!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Is Back and Wants to Rock!
cards.Caption: Let's do a show!
cards.question: Nadia wants gig

cards.comment: Nadia finds a suitcase full of money at her dad's house.\n\tShe promises her father won't miss it and says she thinks the money should be used for the benefit of her own career.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Provides Funds
cards.Caption: Sugar daughter
cards.question: Accept the cash?

cards.comment: Nadia has a creative proposition. She says that she doesn't really think <tmp.name> adds to <¤Cband.name>'s music.\n\tShe says the band would probably do a lot better without {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>, #Object:1]}.
cards.name: Artist

cards.Headline: Nadia Suggests Improvement
cards.Caption: Who wears the pants 'round here?
cards.question: Why don't you just fire <tmp.name>?

cards.comment: Nadia is ripping apart the practice room. Instruments and gear are flying overhead as the rest of the band hides.\n\tNadia is hysterical because <tmp.name> is too happy! She thinks {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>]} is an insensitive moron who should consider others before grinning and singing.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nadia Has a Fit
cards.Caption: Can't stand'em
cards.question: Yeah, yeah

cards.comment: Nadia feels not all of the band has as much musical skill as herself.\n\tShe suggests you get rid of <tmp.name>, whom she feels is the weakest link in <¤Cband.name>.
cards.name: Artist

cards.Headline: Nadia Suggests Improvement
cards.Caption: HR manager
cards.question: Fire <tmp.name>?

cards.comment: Nadia, such an innocent little girl, leaves the band because you could not keep her happy.\n\tThis is a complete failure and you know how Sergey feels about failing.\n\tYou should probably start running.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.question: Start over

cards.comment: You're out of cash, and there's no hope in Sergey giving you more.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.question: Start over

cards.comment: Sergey's patience is tried. You've been given plenty of chances, but you still failed!\n\tSergey does not accept failure. You have let him down and, worse, you have let his beloved daughter down.\n\tSergey suggests you leave Rock City and never come back.
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.question: Start over

cards.comment: Try again and make sure to give the child plenty of gifts to keep her happy.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Start over and spend your money more wisely. Make sure to train Nadia plenty before recording and playing live.\n\tAnd try not to think about what Sergey might do to you
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Try again, and make sure to give Nadia singing lessons.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Want to be famous? A music video on TV is a great way to make you music known to the public. Choose a storyboard to suit your budget and start shooting!
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Music Video

cards.comment: So? All Nadia wanted was to be on TV, but when you finally get the offer you say no?
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Born to Lose
cards.question: What were you thinking?

cards.comment: The Rockets' manager says <¤CBand.name> stole the song and you can look for compensation where the sun don't shine.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: The Rockets Won't Share Their Royalties
cards.question: Go to court?

cards.comment: Er, you fired Nadia? The general idea was for her to be in the band. Don't expect any understanding from Sergey after such a stupid act. Firing his daughter from the band. Duh!
cards.name: Cloak & Dagger
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.question: What were you thinking?

cards.comment: Try again and don't fire the main character this time.
The Rockets agree to give you part of the earnings from "Cry My Eyes Out" to avoid court. They offer you $15.000.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: The Rockets Admit
cards.question: Take the money or go to court!

cards.comment: City News print an article indicating that Firewolf might be breaking up. After a long period of internal conflict, they now have decided go separate ways, it says.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Firewolf Break Up?
cards.Caption: Firewolf Break Up Beef Killed Music
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: <¤CBand.name> causes a minor political crisis when the press reports that the Trade Minister's wife spent the night in <¤CRealMusician.name>'s hotel room.\n\tIt will likely result in divorce and the minister leaving office. Oh well!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Minister's Wife Parties with Band
cards.question: Band causes scandal

cards.comment: The band finds <¤CRealmusician.name> unconscious following a drug overdose.\n\tYou manage to wake him up, but he definitely needs medical attention in order to survive.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> OD
cards.Caption: Overdozed
cards.question: Who do you call first?

cards.comment: Eddie has changed his lifestyle completely. Now he demands that all food being served to him be biodynamically produced, contain no meat and be rinsed in spring water before cooking.\n\tHis new lifestyle is costly and he demands you raise his pay.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie St Jones on Whole Grain Diet
cards.Caption: Healthy lifestyle
cards.question: Give Eddie $500/week raise?

cards.comment: Sonny has met a girl. Her name is Anette and they are very fond of each other. He says she gives him inspiration and calls her his muse.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Finds Love
cards.Caption: Sweet looove of mine
cards.question: Sonny van Lord is in love

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf's music should be harder. She says that nobody likes soft music anymore.\n\tSonny says she's right, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Girlfriend with an Opinion
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf should have a more spectacular stage show.\n\tSome fire, maybe a few dancers and guest artist should do the trick.\n\tSonny thinks that Anette's idea is great, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Girlfriend with an Opinion
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette is disappointed with the media attention lately.\n\tShe thinks that the band members can't handle reporters and that Sonny doesn't get enough attention.\n\tShe suggests that Sonny becomes Firewolf's spokesman in future interviews.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette's Pointers on Interviews
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> met Lola Hertz at a party recently. <¤CRealMusician.firstname> flirted with her in hopes that she would play their songs more often.\n\tIn a dark corner of the party, they let one thing lead to another. Not before long, they were licking each other's ears!\n\tWhen Lola asked <¤CRealMusician.firstname> if he wanted to come back to her place to see some of her etchings, <¤CRealMusician.firstname> got cold feet, saying it was because Lola has such ugly eyebrows!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Hurts Lola of Radio FM
cards.Caption: Sensitive
cards.question: Radio FM hasn't played any <¤Cband.name> songs since

cards.comment: A woman in the audience was hit in the eye by a Mortensen drumstick that slipped from Manny's hand during your recent concert.\n\tApparently, Mortensen drumsticks have extremely low surface friction and therefore easily slip.\n\tThe doctor says she will be OK, but the lady threatens to sue the band for pain and suffering.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Woman Injured in Concert
cards.Caption: <¤Cplace.name>
cards.question: Pay settlement ($10.000) or go to court?

cards.comment: Firewolf are furious that you would try to change their band name. They immediately change it back and warn you about trying anything like that again.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Refuse Name Change
cards.Caption: Mad Eddie
cards.question: Firewolf won't change

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> has recovered from his overdose and is back to business as usual.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Back on Track
cards.Caption: Well again
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> is urgently ill. His doctor sends him to detox because he had a whole pharmacy in his system.\n\t<¤CrealMusician.name> will be out for at least a month.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> at Detox
cards.Caption: Off to the clinic
cards.question: <¤CrealMusician.name> won't be around for some time

cards.comment: The court frees <¤CrealMusician.name> from all charges of abuse, possession and trafficking of drugs.\n\tHis lawyer said Andy's conscience "is as white as snow." That decided things as far as the court was concerned.\n\tAlso, you spot Sergey's car outside the judge's office.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Free of Charges
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Andy's free

cards.comment: The court sentences Andy Rokks to four years incarceration for drug-related activity.\n\tThe motivation behind the sentencing was the organized distribution of drugs at Springfield Elementary School (where both school yard attendants and the students' council where part of the business).\n\tAndy won't be able to play with Firewolf for a few years.
cards.name: Court
cards.Headline: Jailhouse Rock
cards.Caption: Judge Griffin
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Following Andy Rokks' drug offence, the PTA demand that record shops stop selling all Firewolf records.\n\t"Will Firewolf take responsibility if our children become drug addicts? Of course not, they are only interested in money!" says PTA chairman Ed Stone on Radio FM News.
cards.name: The Parent Teacher Association
cards.Headline: PTA Ban Record
cards.Caption: Ed Stone
cards.question: Stop sales of <¤Calbum.name>?

cards.comment: City News run a full page on Andy Rokks drug dealing enterprise.\n\tThe article states that the police found elementary school student directories in Andy's apartment, and that the words "Lick Here" are printed on the inside of Firewolf's record sleeves.\n\tAndy Rokks is, according to City News' sources, cousin of the infamous drug baron Il Conte who has used him to recruit new customers.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Artist Sold Drugs to School Children
cards.Caption: Rock Star Sold Drugs to Children
cards.question: Andy made the papers

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns has slept with Sonny van Lord's girlfriend. They took their chance when Sonny went to the guitar shop to buy strings.\n\tSonny van Lord says he's going to tear Eddie's guts out  literally!\n\tIt might take some time before they can work together again.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Infidelity and Discord
cards.Caption: Couldn't stay away from the honey jar
cards.question: Sonny and Eddie beef

cards.comment: The Parent Teacher Association recommends that record buyers boycott <¤Cband.name> because band musician, <¤CRealmusician.name>, asked audience members during a live show if there were any girls in the crowd who wanted to go backstage and "play his flute."\n\tThe PTA wants everybody who cares for the future of their daughters to avoid the band.
cards.name: The Parent Teacher Association
cards.Headline: PTA Boycott Firewolf
cards.Caption: Let it all hang out
cards.question: PTA suggest boycott

cards.comment: The Promoter claims the demands in your sixty-page rider are preposterous.\n\tIt would cost him $10.000 to heat the venue ahead of time, and you would have to pay for that yourself.\n\tThe alphabet crackers he can arrange, though.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Promoter Contests Demands
cards.Caption: Huge heating bill
cards.question: Pay the $10.000?

cards.comment: Manny Swift pinched one of Sonny van Lord's guitars. Sonny got it back when he threatened to piss in Manny's bass drum, but now the guitar sounds strange.\n\tSonny is grumpy and doesn't want to rehearse.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Manny Swift Nicks Guitar
cards.Caption: Bullied
cards.question: Sonny sulks

cards.comment: Manny Swift only wants to stay in and read all the time, while the rest of Firewolf are busy pouring liquor over each other in night clubs. The band worries about Manny.\n\tManny himself explains that he finds reading more rewarding than drinking.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Manny Likes to Read
cards.Caption: Likes to read
cards.question: Manny won't rock

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord has been infected with a sexually transmitted disease.\n\tIt will go away with a bit of penicillin, but Sonny is so ashamed he doesn't want to be seen in public for a while.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Ill
cards.Caption: Infected
cards.question: Sonny lays low

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord threatens to leave Firewolf. He has had it with the criticism against Anette and says that love is more important than music.\n\tSonny says he can't understand how Firewolf can take Anette's well-meaning advice as criticism. He thinks the rest of the band are ungrateful idiots.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Threatens to Leave Band
cards.Caption: Outta here
cards.question: Sonny threatens leave the band

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord wants to apologise to Firewolf. He has broken up with Anette and regrets that he fought with the band. He apologises for the harsh words.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Back to Square One
cards.Caption: Business as usual again
cards.question: Accept Sonny's apology?

cards.comment: <¤CBand.name>'s new video receives massive media attention.\n\tUnfortunately, it's not a music video, but a film of the band having a liquor and sex orgy with a dozen fans in a hotel room.\n\tNobody knows who shot it, but now it's everywhere.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Wrong Video Makes the News
cards.Caption: Wrong vid
cards.question: What can you do?

cards.comment: The police have apprehended Sonny van Lord at the Mirror Ball men's room where he was having sexual intercourse with another man.\n\tA field day for the press, the pictures of the men being brought out of the nightclub in handcuffs are all over.\n\tSonny is later released without consequences.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Sonny Arrested
cards.Caption: Rock Star had Sex with other Man
cards.question: Sonny came out with a bang

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Manny Swift is not a good enough drummer to be playing with Firewolf.\n\tShe thinks that you should find a better drummer.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Suggests Change
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: Anette gives some advice

cards.comment: The show is delayed because <¤CRealMusician.name> is "sick to his stomach" and vomits in the dressing room for two hours.\n\tThe crowd waits patiently, but when Firewolf finally go on stage, the atmosphere is tense.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Delayed Show
cards.Caption: Sick place
cards.question: Two hours' delay

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name>'s long hair catches in the strings of his guitar.\n\tThe sound engineer runs up with a pair of scissors and cuts loose <¤Crealmusician.firstname>, who finishes the gig with hurt pride.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: <¤Crealmusician.firstname> Caught in Guitar
cards.Caption: Rough cut
cards.question: <¤Crealmusician.firstname>'s hair caught

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord can't find his guitar tuner. It's missing and Sonny doesn't have time to tune his guitars properly before the gig.\n\tAfterwards, the band discovers that Manny hid the tuner, and the band blames him for the disastrous show.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Guitar Tuner Stolen
cards.Caption: No thingy
cards.question: Domestic fight

cards.comment: The record label gives you a letter from some young fans. They are a bunch of ten year olds who send pictures of themselves dressed as <¤CBand.name>.\n\tThe band feel very honoured.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fan Mail
cards.Caption: Popular
cards.question: <¤CBand.name> are down with the kids

cards.comment: Some fans call to say that they have made a fansite for <¤CBand.Name>. Now they want an interview with the band.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Request Interview
cards.question: Give interview?

cards.comment: The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some free tickets to your next show. It would cost <formatCurrency(tmp)>.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Tickets
cards.question: Pay <formatCurrency(tmp)>?

cards.comment: The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can have a few free copies of your new record.\n\tThey want to post a review of the record, and give away copies as prizes for a contest they are holding on their site.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Records
cards.question: Give $500 worth of records?

cards.comment: The fans that did a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some backstage passes for your next show. They feel they've become so close to the band now, that they would like to meet them at the backstage party.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want Backstage Passes
cards.question: Give them backstage passes?

cards.comment: The fans that made a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can travel with <Cband.Name> on the tour. \n  They feel they've really connected with the band and want to tag along on tour.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Want to Go on Tour
cards.question: Let them join?

cards.comment: Notorious instrument maker Mortensen offers <¤Cband.name> $45000 if they use Mortensen gear on all their official appearances.\n\tMortensen are known for subpar quality, but it might be worth the extra dough.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Sponsor Offer
cards.Caption: Mortensen
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> complains that drunken strangers are hanging out in their tour bus all the time.\n\tThe band can't sleep, read, play cards or solve crossword puzzles because of the noise.\n\t<¤CBand.name> are too old to party twenty-four-seven, but this crowd doesn't seem to care.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Fans on the Road
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Ask the fans to leave?

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> says he's had it with all the people hanging out in their dressing room at every gig. \n\tHe wants to know where they all come from and why they always drink all the beer.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CrealMusician.name> Wants some Peace and Quiet
cards.Caption: Angry <¤CrealMusician.firstname>
cards.question: <¤CRealMusician.firstname>'s had it

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> wants to add some extra magic to the show.\n\tHalfway into the gig {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} produces a frog from a box and bites it's head off, much to the crowd's delight.\n\tSoon thereafter {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} begins to vomit and has to leave the stage for an ambulance ride to the emergency room where {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Genitive:1]} stomach is pumped out.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> in Hospital
cards.Caption: Frogeater
cards.question: Don't eat raw frogs

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord feels you have treated his girlfriend Anette unjustly. You say you like her ideas, but you don't act on it.\n\tHe gets the impression you don't really respect her, which means you don't respect him and his skills as a guitarist.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Sonny Disappointed
cards.Caption: Rightly mad
cards.question: You should show some respect!

cards.comment: Andy Rokks has had a psychosis.\n\tAfter emergency electric shock treatment at the hospital, he decides to move back in with his mum and live the safe life with milk and cookies everyday.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Andy Moves Back Home
cards.Caption: Nuts
cards.question: Andy Rokks leaves Firewolf

cards.comment: Halfway through the show, Sonny van Lord changes guitars. When he strikes the first chord on the new guitar, a flash shoots out from the amp.\n\tSonny falls down unconscious and the guitar is on fire. The show ends early, and the promoter only pays half.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Sonny Shocked
cards.Caption: Accidents happen so easily
cards.question: Sonny electrified

cards.comment: Andy Rokks returns from detoxification. He looks a little better, but you should look after him closely.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Andy Back from Detox
cards.Caption: No more tox
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: During practice, Firewolf suddenly stops playing to watch Sonny van Lord's hair stand on end and see electric sparks shoot from his fingers.\n\tThe band laughs, but when Sonny's eyebrows smoke you realise he's in real trouble.\n\tYou push him away from the Mortensen amplifier that is sending electric shocks through his body.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Electrifying Practice Session
cards.Caption: Bzzzz
cards.question: Sonny escapes with a few burned hairs

cards.comment: You agreed to let Firewolf attempt to set a new volume record, but you still haven't booked a show.\n\tThe band are becoming frustrated, because they're eager to play loud.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Record Attempt Requires Show
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Come on, book a date

cards.comment: You still haven't booked a concert for the volume record attempt. Firewolf are so disappointed that they fire you as their manager.\n\tNow they'll find somebody who believes in breaking the sound barrier with them.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: No Gig, No Band
cards.question: You're fired

cards.comment: The publicity for the high volume record attempt works well. City News runs a big story on the upcoming attempt at the volume record.\n\tThey also give a history of high volume records and host an interview with sound scientist Ian Agrosenius, who explains the scientific challenge in creating very loud sounds.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: World Record Attempt Makes the News
cards.Caption: Loudest Band Take  on Volume Record
cards.question: City News seem to like the idea

cards.comment: The band says the next gig is too far off. Someone else could break the record before that  they have even heard a rumor that Fatal Death are trying.\n\tYou should hurry up and book a gig.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Gig Too Late
cards.Caption: <¤CRealMusician.name>
cards.question: Hurry before someone else beats you to it

cards.comment: Firewolf play in g-suits to an overly enthusiastic crowd wearing state of the art ear plugs.\n\tAn official measures a record-shattering 165 dB during Eddie's one minute sustained high note. That's way over the previously set record. The entire concert was louder than the old record!\n\tThe city spends weeks cleaning up the broken glass from the surrounding buildings.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: 165 dB World Record
cards.Caption: 165 dB's of pure metal
cards.question: You made it!

cards.comment: Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.\n\tThey put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.\n\tThanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Firewolf Broke
cards.Caption: Firewolf Fire Manager - The End of Metal?

cards.comment: Try again and spend your cash more wisely this time.\n\tMake sure your concerts are successful by keeping your band happy before the gigs.\n\tCarefully market your record and work the media for free press.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment:
Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.
	They put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.
	Thanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.
	Try again and do better.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Firewolf Give Up
cards.Caption: Firewolf Fire Manager  The End of Metal?

cards.comment: Try again and do better. Make sure you have a successful album out before you embark on a world tour. Do lots of PR and marketing to promote sales.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: <¤Crealmusician.name> has left the band and there's just no way the rest of them are going to continue without him.\n\tThey might fight at times, but Firewolf just wouldn't be Firewolf without the original members.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Give Up

cards.comment: Rule 1A: Keep the band happy. Use any means necessary  gifts, booze, holidays, whatever.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: The last gig was a total failure and Firewolf want to make sure that does not happen again.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record smashing 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tMortensen special equipment and protective gear for another record attempt would set you back $10.000.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Crank It Up!
cards.Caption: Time to challenge the 130 dB record.
cards.question: Challenge the Volume Record at Next Show?

cards.comment: Firewolf are really happy with their last gig, in fact they're so happy they want to do something extra for their next show.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record shattering 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tSpecial equipment and protective gear for the new attempt would set you back $10.000.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Crank It Up!
cards.Caption: Time to challenge the 130 dB record.
cards.question: Challenge the Volume Record at Next Show?

cards.comment: You meet to prepare for the concert, but Andy doesn't show. Time passes and you don't hear anything from him.\n\tAfter waiting, you have to cancel the show. Still nobody seems to know where Andy is at.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Missing
cards.Caption: Mad at Andy
cards.question: Andy's disappeared

cards.comment: The next day, Andy is back. He says he has no idea what happened.\n\tHe doesn't remember anything and doesn't seem to care that the show was cancelled.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Back
cards.Caption: Won't remember
cards.question: Andy's back

cards.comment: Andy Rokks doesn't dare leave his hotel room, because Jolly Roger of The Pirates has said that he's going to kick Andy's ass.\n\tAndy tells the horror tale of how The Pirates manhandled singer/song-writer Eric Flanders at last years Monsters of Mud.\n\tAndy is insecure whether he dares play or not.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Is Scared
cards.Caption: Small and scared
cards.question: Cancel show?

cards.comment: The Pirates are up front yelling profanity during the first half of the gig.\n\tThen Jolly Roger slips in the mud and hits his head on the crowd barrier. They leave.\n\tAndy escapes without a scratch.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: The Pirates Disturb Concert
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: Andy made it

cards.comment: When you arrive to Monsters of Mud you have to wait in line for three hours to get the stage passes. Nobody knows where you are supposed to stay.\n\tThe band leaves you with all the gear to find accommodating groupie-campers.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Practical Matters
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: You sleep in the car

cards.comment: When <¤Cband.name> is going on stage there's no electricity. The gig is delayed 45 minutes.\n\tTo keep the night's schedule, you shorten your set and end up being on stage for twelve minutes.\n\tThe crowd boos and the band sulks.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Delay
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: Short gig today

cards.comment: The threats from Jolly Roger made quite an impact on poor Andy. He just sits in the dressing room staring blindly into the mirror.\n\tAndy trembles like a leaf, spilling drinks and breaking things.\n\tThere's is no way Andy's gonna play tonight.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Andy Rokks Refuses to Play
cards.Caption: Scared witless
cards.question: Show cancelled

cards.comment: Rock festival Monsters of Mud wants to book you for a gig at this year's event.\n\tThey offer $5000 and you'll be gone for a week.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Invitation to Rock Festival
cards.Caption: Monsters of Mud
cards.question: You in?

cards.comment: You take a closer look at the line up for Monsters of Mud and realise <¤Cband.name> are not playing the second biggest stage like you had been promised.\n\tInstead, they're set to play at a remote tent stage early in the afternoon, between two circus acts.
cards.name: Festival
cards.Headline: Wrong Stage
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: Just before the end of the show, something strange happens. Eddie St. Johns pushes Manny Swift's drums over and hits him in the head with a cymbal.\n\tThen the whole band jump in and take turns beating the crap out of Manny with instruments, microphone stands and amplifiers.\n\tAfterwards nobody wants to talk about it, but Manny has to stay in the hospital for a few days.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Firewolf Manhandle Drummer
cards.Caption: Bruises all over
cards.question: Manny got beat

cards.comment: Firewolf have started a contest amongst each other about who can take most groupie scalps.\n\tAside the glory and the odd crab, the winner gets nothing in particular.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Groupie Contest
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment: <¤CrealMusician.name> has started a sort of bonus system to make the roadies get him groupies.\n\tBefore every gig he gives out backstage passes with the roadies' names on. The owner of the backstage pass on the floor of <¤CrealMusician.firstname>'s room the next morning gets $100 and a crate of beer.\n\tEverybody wins, says <¤CrealMusician.firstname>.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Bonus System for the Roadies
cards.Caption: Desirable
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment:
Firewolf can't do the gig because they don't have any instruments!
	At first they say the gear was stolen, but after a while Andy Rokks admits he sold it all to buy drugs. Of course, the rest of the band are furious.
	Andy doesn't want to talk about it because he's been feeling really tired lately.
	Andy shall have to buy the gear back, but now the concert is in jeopardy.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Firewolf Have no Gear
cards.Caption: Sold for Dope
cards.question: Cancel show or buy new gear ($5000)?

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns says he needs a custom made case for the champagne bottle he opens after every show. It might break without it.\n\tThe custom made case will set you back $2000.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie Wants Special Case
cards.Caption: Fragile
cards.question: Pay for the case?

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette wonders why Firewolf's record sales are so bad.\n\tShe thinks that you should buy some more adverts and arrange a gig in the Record Store.\n\tAnette thinks that Firewolf are much better than most bands on the Top 10, and wants to know why aren't they listed.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Disappointed with Sales
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf are ready for a world tour. She wonders if you are really the right manager for them if you can't arrange a world tour.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Anette Demands Tour
cards.Caption: Anette
cards.question: What do you say?

cards.comment: Eddie St. Johns has had it with Anette's constant nagging, criticism and opinions. He can't stand her, put simply.\n\tNow Eddie wants you to tell Sonny that he must choose between Anette and Firewolf.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Eddie St. Johns Fed up with Anette
cards.Caption: Fed up with nagging
cards.question: Give Sonny the ultimatum?

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> has a few specific requests for the next gig.\n\tThe dressing room is to have a temperature of exactly 21ºC at least an hour before Firewolf arrive, otherwise he can't warm up his vocal cords properly.\n\t<¤CRealMusician.firstname> also wants a bowl of alphabet crackers in his dressing room. But only the letter A.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Eddie St. Johns Demands Special Treatment
cards.Caption: Spoiled?
cards.question: Meet Eddie's demands?

cards.comment: Andy Rokks has been arrested. In his apartment was found controlled substances worth thousands.\n\tAlso, there was a metal hatch in his front door. Looks like Andy had another job on the side.\n\tAnyway, now he's gonna have to go to court, but he is out on bail until the trial.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Drug Accusations
cards.Caption: Dealer?
cards.question: Tell the press?

cards.comment: Spotlight Tours call to offer their services as a tour promoter for your artists. It is Firewolf's good sales lately that has sparked their interest.
cards.name: World Tour
cards.Headline: Spotlight Tours Offer
cards.question: Visit Spotlight to book tour

cards.comment: Douglas of City News calls to find out why the band hasn't split up yet. You told him the rumors where true.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Request Comment
cards.Caption: In doubt
cards.question: What do you tell him?

cards.comment: Zer0 Magazine wants an interview with Nick Chesterton.\n\tHis comeback is a big thing among their readers and Zer0 think the interview would help you promote the record.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Request Interview
cards.Caption: Excited
cards.question: Give them the interview?

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton finds out you've set him up for an interview with Zer0 Magazine, but there's just no chance he's gonna do an interview.\n\tHe has made perfectly clear that he wants nothing to do with the media.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Interview
cards.Caption: No way, José
cards.question: He won't do it

cards.comment: Nick asks how long it's gonna take before you release a record.\n\tAll this indecision is making him doubt his comeback. He's just not sure whether he can do it or not.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Growing Restless
cards.Caption: Cold feet
cards.question: Nick is getting uneasy

cards.comment: After a few days on his holiday, Nick Chesterton is recognised by fans and reporters at the resort.\n\tHe escapes to his bungalow, but they wait outside and Nick is worried they might touch the room service meals he orders before he can eat them.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Harrassed by Fans and Media
cards.Caption: No rest
cards.question: The holiday wasn't all that relaxing

cards.comment: The liquor you gave Nick Chesterton has made him really ill.\n\tHe can barely speak, much less sing, and spends all day in his room with the blinds shut, plucking absent-mindedly on his guitar between the vomiting fits.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Takes Ill
cards.Caption: Not too good with booze
cards.question: Nick is ill

cards.comment: As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThey all want a piece of Nick and you have to fight to get him out of there.\n\tNick is really shaken by the incident and doubts if the comeback was such a good idea after all.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Incident Shakes Nick
cards.Caption: Shaken, not stirred
cards.question: Nick's mood worsened

cards.comment: As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards elegantly smuggle him out through an air shaft to escape the reporters. Problem solved.\n\tSome papers run admiring accounts of the movie-style escape.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Got away clean
cards.question: Sergey's bodyguards did their thing

cards.comment:
There is a  huge media posse waiting outside the concert hall after the show.
	You try to wait them out, but they persist. You have to fight your way through a wall of reporter flesh!
	They don't even bother asking any questions, they just grab at Nick for a piece of hair, skin or clothes.
	Finally, you get away with Nick in disarray and bruises all over his body.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Attack Nick
cards.Caption: Treated roughly
cards.question: Nick is disturbed

cards.comment: As you exit concert, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside for you.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards set off the fire alarm and sneak Nick out the back door, unseen by any reporter in the midst of the confusion.\n\tSomebody must have leaked the escape to the press because City News and Zer0 Magazine both print admiring descriptions of the daring escape.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Got away clean
cards.question: Sergey's men sorted it out

cards.comment: After the concert, the hungry media anxiously waits to get a piece of Nick Chesterton.\n\tAs he tries to wade through the crowd, the pressure becomes too much and Nick collapses on the ground.\n\tWhen the ambulance arrives, the reporters have already left to write their pieces on celebrity hysteria, media ethics and low security at concerts.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Attack Nick
cards.Caption: Collapsed
cards.question: Nick will recover in a few days

cards.comment: After the concert, hungry reporters anxiously wait to get a piece of your star.\n\tThe paparazzi refuse to back down until the Spektor bodyguards pull out their guns and threaten to fire at will. That does the trick -  you can leave safely!\n\tSome media report on the incident, making Nick feel very awkward.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Media Avoided by Bodyguards
cards.Caption: Safe but disturbed
cards.question: Nick is feeling uneasy

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is angry with you because you hired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>.\n\tHe can't play with such heavy metal freaks. His music has nuances that metal heads can't even begin to fathom and if you can't understand it, then how could you play it?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Unhappy with Musician
cards.Caption: No, seriously
cards.question: Nick wants rid of <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is angry with you for not having fired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>. He is unsure if he can trust you anymore.\n\tIf you don't hire and fire the musicians he chooses, how can he trust you with the press?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Questions Manager
cards.Caption: Do what I say!
cards.question: Nick wants rid of <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is furious that you would schedule him for a video shoot.\n\tHe refuses to ever appear in any video! That goes against everything that Nick Chesterton is about.\n\tYou can cancel the shoot or make it without him.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Video Shoot
cards.Caption: No! No! No!
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: <missionVar.Mis6Booredmusician.name> is fed up with Nick Chesterton's egoism and eccentricity.\n\tIt's so boring working with somebody who spends half the days just dealing with his neurosis.\n\tNo great music is being made.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Artist Bored
cards.Caption: Cooperation difficulties
cards.question: Criticism against Nick

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton is very upset that you would set him up for an interview, knowing about his feelings towards the media.\n\tHe refuses to be interviewed.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Refuses Interview
cards.Caption: No-can-do
cards.question: You should know better!

cards.comment: Nick Chesterton has managed to sell 30.000 copies and made enough money to creep back into the abyss where he used to dwell.\n\tThere's nothing more you can do for him and he's gonna be happier this way anyhow.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Retires
cards.Caption: Leaving the limelight
cards.question: Mission over

cards.comment: The music industry yearly Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies are coming up.\n\tAmong the nominees for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar is Nick Chesterton. With the nomination comes an offer to play a song live at the ceremonies which will be held in a week.\n\tThe promoters demand you pay $10.000 to do the gig, but it's great promotion.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Gold Wiener Nomination
cards.Caption: The Gold Wiener
cards.question: Do the gig?

cards.comment:
After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.
	The stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, T-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).
	The Spektor bodyguards swiftly disperse the crowd by playing heavy metal over the PA at a painful volume.
	Nick escapes unharmed, but spends half an hour telling you how he feels about heavy metal.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Prize winner
cards.question: Nick won the award!

cards.comment: After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.\n\tThe stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, t-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).\n\tAt first Nick is thrilled, but it's not long before he panics and runs screaming off the stage.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Nick Chesterton Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Prize winner
cards.question: Nick won the award!

cards.comment: You attend the Gold Wiener Awards, but Nick doesn't win anything.\n\tThe Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar goes to Eric Flanders, who played at the gala and is overjoyed as the stage fills with teenage fans wanting to celebrate his genius.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Eric Flanders Wins Gold Wiener
cards.Caption: Nick didn't get it
cards.question: You can't win them all, right?

cards.comment: Start over and think twice about your expenses. Do you really need to use the most expensive studios and gear?
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Your number one priority should be to keep Nick in the band!
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Nick is torn to pieces because you have considered recording a song other than his masterpiece, Mountain of Hypocrisy.\n\tThe only thing Nick ever wanted to do was make his music  the reason why he puts up with media madness.\n\tHe immediately goes back to his cocoon with the intent to stay there forever.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nick Giving Up
cards.Caption: Back to hibernation
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: The Gold Wiener Gala is almost over and host Al "Corny" Caprice is about to crack tonight's last joke, when <¤Cband.name> charge on stage.\n\t<¤CRealMusicianDrums.Name> is riding on Roy Dowert's back and catches "Corny" with a tablecloth lasso.\n\tThey conquer the mic and declare to the world, "Music and love make the world go round!" before security remove them from the stage.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Space Cadet Scandal
cards.Caption: Artists Attack Gala Host "Corny"
cards.question: Gold Wiener intermezzo

cards.comment: <¤Cband.name> are nominated for a Gold Wiener in the Intricate Singing-category.\n\tThe Gold Wiener is the music industry's yearly award ceremony in which prominent artists and businesses are credited for contributing to the progress of the music business.\n\tWinning a Gold Wiener is highly regarded.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Space Cadets Nominated for Gold Wiener
cards.question: Gold Wiener nomination

cards.comment: Champagne corks pop as award presenter Billy Mutton announces the winner in the Intricate Singing-category. <¤Cband.name> win the Gold Wiener!\n\tThey celebrate by spraying each other with champagne and throwing canapés at the trade minister.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Space Cadets Win Gold Wiener
cards.question: Space Cadets won!

cards.comment: No Gold Wiener for <¤Cband.name> this time around.\n\tThe prize for Intricate Singing was awarded to The M.A.C.K for the song Steamy Lovin', a crap tune according to your band.\n\tBut the band doesn't appear to be too disappointed, busy as they are filling mouths and pockets with free beer and food from the buffet.
cards.name: Music Industry
cards.Headline: Space Cadets Get Nothing
cards.question: You didn't win

cards.comment: The music makes the under-stimulated orphanage kids go berserk.\n\tIn a matter of minutes, they've destroyed all your gear and most of the orphanage's furniture.\n\tYou are curtly sent away by the headmistress.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Orphanage Gig Disaster
cards.question: Pay $10000 to repair the gear!

cards.comment: The staff are touched by the beautiful concert and by your concern for the poor orphans.\n\tThe poor orphans themselves seem more interested in bullying a fat kid than listening to your music.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Orphanage Gig Succesful
cards.question: Good show

cards.comment: The record label want you to do a PR-gig at an orphanage.\n\tWhen Lucy Birch hears about it, she bursts out crying. It turns out that she's an orphan herself and she insists you do the gig.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Orphanage PR-visit
cards.Caption: Orphan
cards.question: Do the gig?

cards.comment: Your funds are limited so spend them carefully. You may try again and make sure to do better this time.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You're broke. The game is over. <¤Cband.name> decide to give up. Now they'll return to their day jobs in various record shops.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Game Over

cards.comment: <¤Crealmusician.name>'s leaving the band has made the rest of <¤cband.name> doubt whether this really is the right thing for them.\n\tAll worry except Lucy, who doesn't seem to care.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Doubts Torment <¤Cband.name>
cards.Caption: Too cool for school
cards.question: Lucy's cool, though

cards.comment:
As a leftover from the past "space" concept days, <¤cband.name> have kept the band mascot  a "space" hamster called Ugly.
	The poor rodent's life ended tragically today when Lucy accidentally stepped on him , puncturing him with her stiletto heel.
	The band is shaken and some see it as a bad omen.
	Lucy herself doesn't seem to care much about Ugly's passing, pointing out that "one can always buy a new rat should the need occur."
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Lucy Kills Ugly
cards.Caption: Ugly's bane
cards.question: Tragic incident

cards.comment: City News critic Douglas Marvel seems to consider <¤Calbum.name> a personal insult.\n\t"A spit in the face of those serious about music. Anyone involved in the recording or distribution of this stinking rat's carcass of a record ought to be shot for crimes against humanity.\n\t"I've come to realise if the Devil does indeed exist, he comes in the shape of <¤Cband.name>. From this moment on, I promise to dedicate all of my effort as a music journalist to ending the curse, the horror, the abomination that is <¤Cband.name>."
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Review
cards.Caption: Worst Record Ever
cards.question: Worst ever review (0/5)

cards.comment:
Madman Douglas Marvel delivers another slap of abuse in today's City News:
	"<¤Calbum.name> is so bad, it leaves me no rest. I can't stop listening and the more I listen, the more I hate it.
	"Someone please help me stop this nightmare! Hurt me! Torture me! Put needles under my fingernails and set my hair on fire! Do whatever you need to stop me from listening to the painful sounds of <¤Cband.name>.
	"It's them or me as we cannot co-exist. If you're not part of the solution, you're part of the problem!"
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Marvel Strikes Again
cards.Caption: The Pain! The Pain!
cards.question: Doug lost the plot

cards.comment: There's a knock on the door of the practice room and you're surprised to find raving lunatic Douglas Marvel outside, hair on end, carrying a huge sign saying "Stop <¤Cband.name>!"\n\tHe wants to tell the band in person how he feels about the music they make. He humbly asks them to find other means of supporting themselves than through music.\n\tThen he leaves as suddenly as he came.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Marvel Pays a Visit
cards.Caption: Scared!
cards.question: Is this guy for real?

cards.comment: Marty feels real awkward about how the media in general and Douglas Marvel in particular have been acting toward <¤Cband.name>.\n\tHe is beginning to feel that being in a band may not be worth it.\n\tMarty is considering leaving music to pursue a career as a bus boy.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Marty Expressing Doubt
cards.Caption: Time to move on?
cards.question: Marty's getting second thoughts

cards.comment:
Last night, Lucy Birch ran into a well loaded Douglas Marvel in the popular night club Mirror Ball.
	<¤Cband.name>'s sworn enemy immediately came on to her, but Lucy politely resisted Marvel's driveling persuasions.
	When he started groping for her bosom, Lucy made security escort him out of her sight.
	Lucy doesn't appear disturbed by the incident.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Nightclub Encounter
cards.Caption: Object of desire
cards.question: Lucy harassed by Marvel

cards.comment: Radio FM reporter Lola Hertz gets wind of Marvel's behaviour toward Lucy Birch and is furious.\n\tApparently he met ms.
