Hertz on the very same evening and told her she had bad taste in music.\n\tLola offers to do a live debate with <¤Cband.name> versus Douglas Marvel on the radio as an attempt to put an end to the madness.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Radio FM Offer
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: <¤Cband.name> are not able to articulate themselves during the broadcasted debate.\n\tAny attempt they make to counter the verbal onslaught falls short compared to the rhetorical whirlwind that is Douglas Marvel.\n\tWhen the one hour debate is over, Marvel has convinced even Lola Hertz that <¤Cband.name> is a menace to society and should be treated accordingly.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Marvel Humbles <¤Cband.name>
cards.question: You blew it

cards.comment:
The radio debate becomes <¤Cband.name>'s finest hour.
	Douglas Marvel stutters incoherently for a few minutes before he shuts up completely, leaving the airwaves to <¤Cband.name>.
	The band puts Marvel's outrage into perspective with an open-hearted account of how although their music may not be the most original ever to be put on a record, it is still the work of passion and honesty.
	Later, you are informed that Marvel has taken a long leave of absence from his position with City News.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Maniac Marvel Humbled
cards.question: Sweet victory

cards.comment: Following the radio debate, Zer0 Magazine prints a <¤Calbum.name> review full of praise.\n\tThey call the record "a statement against narrow-mindedness and musical elitism" and add an insightful remark stating how they as critics often are too quick to dismiss aspiring artists as talentless one-hit-wonders.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Review
cards.Caption: Honesty Prevails over Arrogance
cards.question: Great review (4/5)

cards.comment: Zer0 Magazine prints a review that sides with Douglas Marvel.\n\t"<¤Cband.name> is to the 21st century what the Black Death was to the Dark Ages. On Sunday, Zer0 Magazine will arrange a public burning of <¤Calbum.name> in Rock City Main Square.\n\t"Show up and burn your copy!"
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Review
cards.Caption: Evil Music Must\nBe Stopped
cards.question: Terrible review (0/5)

cards.comment: Roy Dowert just makes it when a huge stack of amplifiers fall on stage.\n\tThe band keeps playing but the sound is a bit strange.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Amps Fall
cards.Caption: <¤CPlace.Name>
cards.question: Living on the edge

cards.comment: In the middle of the set, Roy Dowert has an inspired moment and tries to climb the light rig.\n\tRoy climbs very high  before he falls! He falls and breaks his arm (and the show).\n\tNow he'll have to lay low for a few days.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Roy Breaks Arm
cards.Caption: No climbing ace
cards.question: Roy out for a few days

cards.comment: During the intro for the first song, Roy walks up to the front of the stage to greet the crowd. Unfortunately he trips on some cables, falls from the stage and breaks his foot.\n\tThe roadies pull him backstage while the band continues to play the intro for a few minutes more. Soon they give up and leave while the crowd boos.\n\tRoy has to wear a cast for a few weeks.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Roy Breaks Foot
cards.Caption: Cast
cards.question: Short gig today

cards.comment: The show is interrupted by the police charging onto the stage arresting Roy Dowert.\n\tHe exposed himself on stage, which was the only excuse the police needed to arrest him.\n\tRoy is released a few hours later, fully dressed and without legal consequences.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Roy Dowert Arrested
cards.Caption: Exhibitionist?
cards.question: Roy was arrested

cards.comment: Halfway through the show Roy Dowert gets some feeling and jumps into the crowd.\n\tA roadie runs out and starts pulling the microphone cable back. He gets the mic, but no Roy.\n\tThe band keeps playing for a while, before they stop and go backstage. The audience boos, but Roy is nowhere to be found.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Roy Disappears from Stage
cards.Caption: <¤CPlace.Name>
cards.question: Roy missing

cards.comment: Roy's mysterious disappearance  troubles the band members.\n\tThey worry about him, place phone calls to his friends asking his whereabouts, and generally do what worried people do.\n\tLucy Birch  on the other hand  only shrugs, like Roy will be back when he is ready.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Roy Missing Makes Band Uneasy
cards.Caption: Keeping cool
cards.question: All but Lucy worry for Roy

cards.comment: Having been gone for three full days, Roy Dowert walks in to the practice room still in his stage costume.\n\tHe says he doesn't remember clearly what happened, but some kind girls drove him home.\n\tThey drove for about three hours, which is a tad strange considering <getObjByID(missionvar.roydisappearplaceID).name> is three blocks from the practice room.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Roy Returns
cards.Caption: Remembers nada
cards.question: Explain that if you can

cards.comment: <¤Cband.name> do a scandal by going on stage nude for the encore. The crowd love it and it's a field day for the photographers.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Nude Shock
cards.Caption: NUDE SHOCK!
cards.question: <¤Cband.name> go naked

cards.comment: Your poor handling of the media became the end of <¤Cband.name>.\n\tTry again, and this time try to maintain a good relation to the ladies and gentlemen of the press.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: The media's declaration of war against <¤Cband.name> is quite the opposite of what the band had in mind when they hired you as their manager.\n\tThe band gives up the hopeless fight and go back to living lives far from the show-biz frenzy.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: History
cards.question: You're out

cards.comment: <¤Crealmusician.name> leaving <¤Cband.name> was the last stroke of bad luck.\n\tThe rest of the band decide it's time to realise that they don't have what it takes to compete in a world like this.\n\tIt's better they stop pretending and go back to their old day jobs at LardBurger.
cards.name: Info
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: History
cards.question: No more mr Big Shot Manager

cards.comment: You should try to keep the band together.\n\tThey can probably survive one person leaving the band, but two is too many.\n\tTry again and spend more time taking care of your artists.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Sandeater, front man for The Desert Demons, invites you to play at their Desert Aid-gala.\n\tAll revenue goes to the thirsty desert-peoples of  the world. Theres no pay, but maybe some good publicity.\n\tAnd of course to help the thirsty people.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Charity Show
cards.Caption: Sandeater
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: Desert Aid is a success.\n\tExcept that the Palladium is sold out, City News prints a full page on <¤Cband.Name> and Desert Demons, reporting on your strong dedication to the cause of the thirsty desert-peoples of the world.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Successful Charity Show
cards.Caption: Sandeater
cards.question: Desert Aid went well

cards.comment: Desert Aid wasn't such a great idea after all.\n\tJust a few school groups on an excursion showed up for the concert. City News prints a paragraph declaring both <¤cband.name> and Desert Demons idiots. Nobody lives in the desert, so there's no one who needs help!\n\tNo great day for <¤cband.name>.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Fiasco
cards.Caption: Sandeater
cards.question: Forget about it and move on

cards.comment: Superstars Ghost in the Machine offer <¤cband.name> to open for their upcoming tour.\n\tThey will do eight shows around the world and it would be an opportunity for <¤cband.name> to play abroad.\n\tGhost in the Machine wants you to pay $50.000 to support them.
cards.name: World Tour
cards.Headline: Support Act Offer
cards.question: Pay $50.000?

cards.comment: You still haven't signed a contract with Rainbow records, and Global honcho G. Jerome Vonderbaldt is getting edgy.\n\tThe only way for his plan to work is through a record deal with Rainbow, so get to it!
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Global Question Your Competence
cards.Caption: Don't let him down
cards.question: Hurry, hurry

cards.comment: There could be no doubt about your task: Your mission was to sign with Rainbow Records and bury them.\n\tGlobal even reminded you about the details, and you still haven't taken the first step towards finishing the plan!\n\tYou're all out of chances, manager.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: You don't get it, do you?
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Oh, come on! You're going bring Rainbow down by signing with a different label?\n\tThat would be a clever idea if that was what Global had asked you to do. When you work with Global, you should follow their instructions.\n\tYou won't be working with them anymore.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: Wrong label!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: For Global's plan to proceed, you need to have a record contract with Rainbow.\n\tHowever, you just cancelled you're contract with Rainbow, terminating Global's plan!\n\tIt should come as no surprise when Global fires your moronic ass!
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: You should have listened
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Rainbow Records boss Karen McLaren is devastated that you can't keep the members of  <¤Cband.name> together.\n\tThat band is her golden calf, you know. All of Rainbow's future is invested in them.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Rainbow Criticism
cards.Caption: Devastated
cards.question: Try harder to keep them happy

cards.comment: That's the second band member quitting <¤Cband.name>. Rainbow doesn't trust you as a manager anymore.\n\tSorry, but you're out.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: That's it!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Rainbow boss Karen McLaren is disappointed that <¤cband.name>'s career isn't moving as fast as they had hoped.\n\tShe reluctantly approves an additional $40.000 advance to give them a push in the right direction.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Extra Advance
cards.Caption: Reluctantly paying
cards.question: You get another 40G

cards.comment: Rainbow is really mad at you for spending all of its money on useless ad campaigns.\n\tYou're fired.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: Sorry, no cash
cards.question: You're fired

cards.comment: Rainbow is angry with you for spending all their money on strange and probably illegal services from known criminals.\n\tYou cannot convince the label that such action is necessary, because Rainbow Records is not going to run an illegal operation.\n
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: Sorry, no cash
cards.question: You're fired

cards.comment: Rainbow is angry with you for spending all of its money on gifts to the band.\n\tRainbow Records is not in the habit of spoiling of its artists and that policy applies to you, too.\n
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: Sorry, no cash
cards.question: You're fired

cards.comment: Rainbow Records boss Karen McLaren is concerned that <¤Cband.name> still hasn't become the new hit artist her label badly needs.\n\tHowever, at a board meeting Rainbow has decided to put the last of its financial resources into this project, sink or swim.\n\tAll the label has is $40.000, so put it to good use.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: One Last Advance
cards.Caption: Desperate measures
cards.question: You get their last 40G

cards.comment: Trying to hold back tears of anger, Rainbow boss Karen McLaren explains that your total incompetence as a manager has ruined the company.\n\tRainbow Records had a forty year history as a record label, often releasing artists that the bigger labels wouldn't sign, and thereby making invaluable contributions to the music industry.\n\tRainbow used to be the music lover's label, but that's all over now because of you.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Rainbow Out of Business
cards.Caption: Broke
cards.question: No more music lovers

cards.comment: Rainbow is angry with you for spending so much money on useless ad campaigns.\n\tKaren McLaren doubts whether you are the right person for the job.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Rainbow Criticism
cards.Caption: Suspicious
cards.question: They're not happy

cards.comment: Rainbow is angry with you for spending so much money on strange and probably illegal services from known criminals.\n\tThe company does not believe such action is necessary, simply because Rainbow will not operate illegally.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Rainbow Criticism
cards.Caption: Suspicious
cards.question: They're not happy

cards.comment: Rainbow is very angry with you for spending so much of its money on gifts to the band.\n\tRainbow Records is not in the habit of spoiling its artists, and that policy applies to you, too.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Rainbow Criticism
cards.Caption: Suspicious
cards.question: They're not happy

cards.comment: <missionVar.YouSuckMusician.name> thinks you are a useless manager.\n\tWhy won't you even try just a little bit? Don't you want to make it?\n\tDon't you know that Rainbow's future depends on your success?
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Artist Criticism
cards.Caption: Angry
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment: <missionVar.YouSuckMusician.name> is on to you!\n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} knows about your deal with Global Records and the plan to run Rainbow out of business.\n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} threatens to expose the entire plan to Rainbow unless {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} gets part of the action: a new $5000 wide screen television!
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Artist Blackmail
cards.Caption: Greedy
cards.question: Buy the TV?

cards.comment: Rainbow Records discovered that you are a traitor.\n\tThe company fired you out of anger, and has hired thugs to beat you to a pulp. You will never set foot in Rock City again.\n\tGlobal denies any knowledge of your existence.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: That's it!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: The plan was to bring Rainbow down by not selling any records, but now it seems that <¤Cband.name> are making sales.\n\tGlobal Records worries that you won't deliver.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Global Question Sales
cards.Caption: What's going on?
cards.question: 2000 records sold

cards.comment: Global Records fires you.\n\tYou've sold too many records and <¤Cband.name> are becoming an important asset for Rainbow Records.\n\tQuite the opposite of the original plan! It seems that Rainbow might even make it, a delight to the world's true music lovers but much to the grief of your employer.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: That's it!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Rainbow boss Karen McLaren is furious that you have spent all of the label's money without releasing a record.\n\tThis is not what she had in mind, and you better believe that Rainbow won't throw cash around like some other labels.\n\tYou're fired.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Game Over
cards.Caption: Just won't pay
cards.question: Du får sparken

cards.comment: Global honcho G. Jerome Vonderbaldt suggests that you waste all of Rainbow's money on useless stuff to help cause the small label's failure.\n\tHe suggests you also squeeze as much cash as possible out of the flower-lovers.\n\tHowever, it's imperative that Rainbow doesn't know about the plan. Be careful!
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Pointers from Global
cards.Caption: Listen carefully
cards.question: Got it?

cards.comment: What have you learned about money? Don't waste it!\n\tConsider that when you start over.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You were supposed to bring Rainbow down by spending all their money. In that case, you better try to sell as few records as possible. Otherwise, you're making them money, do you see? Don't sell so many records next time, okay?
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You're supposed to sign with Rainbow. The plan was to bring them down by spending all their money. For that to work you need a record contract with Rainbow, right? Try again and try not to be so stupid this time around, OK?
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: You're supposed to sign with Rainbow. The plan was to bring them down by spending all their money. For that to work you need a record contract with Rainbow, right? Try again and try not to be so stupid this time around, OK?
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Now, for the plan to work out, you have to stick with Rainbow. Keep the contract with them at any cost. Make sure they have no reason to fire you!
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Rainbow-boss Karen McLaren is furious that you have spent all her label's money on song licenses.\n\tThe Rainbow funds are limited! You're an experienced manager and should make do with one or two songs.\n\tFeeling deceived by your incompetence, Karen McLaren terminates your agreement.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: That's it!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Rainbow boss Karen McLaren thinks you are unfit to manage her artists.\n\tHow can you record so many songs and not sell any of them?
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: That's it!
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: A handful of fans have set up camp outside the practice room. They sleep in tents and cook on camp stoves.\n\tEvery time somebody comes or goes, the fans take pictures and ask for autographs.\n\tAt first the band enjoys the attention, but quickly get tired.
cards.name: Fans
cards.Headline: Fans Camping Outside Practice Room
cards.question: What to do?

cards.comment:
What are you? Stupid? This is The Perfect Band, remember?
	Your not supposed to change it, because any change would make it less than perfect.
	Global honcho G Jerome Vonderbaldt is rightly upset and changes it back to the Perfect set up.
	You better think about what you're doing.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Don't Change the Perfect Band
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Perfect Band changed back

cards.comment: You were supposed to keep this band together.\n\tNot that the musicians really matter  they will never be perfect  but Global has decided it cannot trust you any longer.\n\tGlobal will find somebody else to manage The Perfect Band.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Sorry, you're out

cards.comment: Global won't let you record anything other than The Perfect song.\n\tYou didn't really think you'd get away with that, did you?
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Don't Change the Perfect Song
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Sorry, you're out

cards.comment: Good news! While you were recording, Global's scientists developed The Perfect Style  clothes and shoes to suit The Perfect Band.\n\tNow The Perfect Band is one step closer to perfection.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: The Perfect Style
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Put them on!

cards.comment: The best thing since fire!" writes Zer0 Magazine reporter Andy Fairlane in his ecstatic review of The Perfect Band's concert.\n\t"These stars shine brighter than the lights of Colosseum," and "This is the definite band, or my name ain't Andy Fairlane."\n\tThe Perfect Band makes him forget all other bands in the history of rock
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Critic Overwhelmed
cards.Caption: \nThe Future Is Now!
cards.question: Good review

cards.comment: The Perfect Band have broken the sales record for the first week. In fact, sales the first week were three times higher than the previous record.\n\tIt seems that all types of people are buying <¤Calbum.name>.
cards.name: Sales
cards.Headline: Sales Record
cards.Caption: The Only Band the World Needs!
cards.question: Good sales

cards.comment: Zer0 Magazine has heard about the new Rock 'n' Roll sensation The Perfect Band.\n\tThey are desperate to get an interview, before everyone else beats them to it.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Magazine Request Interview
cards.Caption: Anxious to get the new hype
cards.question: Give Zer0 Magazine the interview?

cards.comment: Despite refusing an interview, The Perfect Band are on the front page of the new Zer0 Magazine issue.\n\tThey print sixteen pages about the band, including creative reconstruction of the bands history, poetic reference to an old racing movie and a heartfelt tribute to their integrity (as they won't do interviews).\n\tThe editor promises his readers to never print a line about another band again. From now on Zer0 Magazine is going to be completely about The Perfect Band.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Print Perfect Article
cards.Caption: All Hail \nThe Perfect Band!
cards.question: Zer0 seem to like the band

cards.comment: The Zer0 interview treats The Perfect Band's every word like that of an oracle.\n\tWhen Alba says he dreams of being able to live off of his music, the reporter interprets it as a message to the world that we should all work less and play more music to make this planet a better place.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Zer0 Print Perfect Interview
cards.Caption: \nPerfect Indeed!
cards.question: Great interview!

cards.comment: Word of TPB's grandeur has reached the classic concert venue Avenue. They want the band to do a gig as soon as possible.\n\tThey will gladly pay $10.000 for the honour of hosting TPB.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Avenue Offer Concert
cards.Caption: Classic place
cards.question: Do the gig?

cards.comment: The critics all agree that The Perfect Band gave the perfect concert last night.\n\tCity News prints that TPB are bound to bring world peace, and a Radio FM reports that TPB's music reaches "biblical proportions."
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Concert Pleases Critics
cards.Caption: Setting New Standards for Rock
cards.question: Great reviews!

cards.comment: It is unheard of that Avenue would invite a band to play  it's always been the other way around.\n\tIn contrast it is unheard of that a band would even turn down such an offer!\n\tCity News admires your courage and says that only a talented band like The Perfect Band could get away with that.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: Press Praise Perfect Band
cards.Caption: Great Balls of Perfect
cards.question: Press impressed

cards.comment: Lola Hertz of Radio FM humbly asks if her station could have the honour of airing The Perfect Band's next concert.\n\tIt will be a prime time show and she would happily pay $12,000, which is this year's music budget.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Radio FM Request
cards.Caption: Prepared to pay
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: They've been building up towards this moment for a week:\n\tThere is a countdown presentation for The Perfect Song every fifteen minutes, and every thirty minutes there's a Perfect Band competition. Every hour Lola Hertz presents a piece of Perfect Band-trivia.\n\tRadio FM air a unique live broadcast of The Perfect Band's concert for the first time. The performance will be aired several hundred times more before the end of this month.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Radio FM Air Concert
cards.question: Radio FM deliver

cards.comment: The decline to broadcast didn't stop Radio FM from contributing to the hype.\n\tInstead of the concert, they air a panel debate with the country's finest musical experts.\n\tUnlike other such shows, the participants all agree on The Perfect Band's genius and try to outdo each other in praising them.
cards.name: Radio
cards.Headline: Panel Debate Replaces Concert
cards.question: Experts also like TPB

cards.comment: Luxury car maker Ferretti wants to use The Perfect Song in a commercial for TPB inspired new sports model, "The Perfect Car."\n\tThey will pay $30.000 for the license.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Commercial Offer
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: World-famous fashion designer Cornelius Pablo thinks that The Perfect Band are just so frighteningly right.\n\tHe wants them to present his new haute couture collection on the catwalk in Paris next month.\n\tHe will pay $20.000.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: The Perfect Catwalk?
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: The band informs you they have accepted an offer from Global Films to appear in 18th century costume drama feature entitled The Baroness's Kiss. The contract has already been signed.\n\tGlobal Films will pay $50.000 for their participation.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: TPB Sign Movie Contract
cards.question: TPB to appear in movie

cards.comment: TV24 show a one-hour "behind-the-scenes" documentary about the making of The Baroness's Kiss.\n\tMost of the program focuses on The Perfect Band's participation in the movie and their fantastic talent as actors.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: The Making of The Baroness's Kiss
cards.question: TV24 enter the bandwagon

cards.comment: The motion picture The Baroness's Kiss, featuring The Perfect Band, opens on thousands of silver screens around the globe.\n\tRecord box office sales are broken including the biggest gross earnings opening night, most tickets sold, biggest global earnings, best overall reviews, best audience satisfaction and so on.\n\tGlobal Films pay you a $100.000 bonus.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Box Office Record
cards.question: $100.000 bonus

cards.comment:
The Perfect Band gives a free "concert of love" at the Taj Mahal in India.
	Thousands of fans travel from all over the globe and more than five thousand reporters cover the event.
	Of course it is an outstanding success in the name of love (what did you expect?). The Perfect Band appears in specially designed pink suits to celebrate the event.
	City News calls it "The beginning of a new religion."
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Taj Mahal Love Concert
cards.question: Love gig, huh?

cards.comment: The City News' Arts & Culture section posts a special edition on The Perfect Band from a postmodern point-of-view.\n\tAll the important intellectuals take the opportunity to elaborate on the transcendental theme that is central to The Perfect Band's work, and emphasize the vast impact they've had on redefining the public perception of their art by juxtaposing the imperatives of the artist and the audience.
cards.name: Press
cards.Headline: City News Special Edition
cards.Caption: TPB Challenge Archaic Hegemony
cards.question: Academic analysis

cards.comment: The Perfect Band is invited to play at the Olympic Games opening ceremonies next week. The show will be broadcast live via satellite all over the globe.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Olympic Opening Offer
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: The Olympic opening ceremonies are a dull event and even the participants themselves seem to be waiting only for the TPB gig.\n\tAt last the band plays while peace pigeons fly over the stadium, fireworks light the sky and twenty thousand school children all dressed in white enter the stadium, each carrying a bunch of white roses which they lay before the stage.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Perfect Band Open Olympics
cards.question: Oh, how pretty!

cards.comment: The British court dub The Perfect Band as knights. Now they may call themselves Sir Perfect Band, if they wish.\n\tYou weren't knighted.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Perfect Band Knighted
cards.question: Knighthood isn't what it used to be

cards.comment: The band inform you that they plan to do a gig at the foot of the Cheops Pyramid in Giza, Egypt, since the Taj Mahal concert of love was such a big success.\n\tEverything's already been decided by Global and the gig is only days away.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: Perfect Band Announce Gig
cards.question: Who's wearing the pants 'round here?

cards.comment: Like you would expect, the Pyramid show is an outstanding success and the critics grow lyrical trying to describe the feeling of The Perfect Song in the cool desert night in such a special setting.\n\tThe band now is discussing a gig atop the Great Wall of China  the world's longest concert!
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Pyramid Gig
cards.question: Yeah, yeah

cards.comment: The Perfect Song sets a new sales record. It has now sold more copies than all the other records in the world put together.
cards.name: Sales
cards.Headline: Sales Record
cards.question: Millions, millions, millions

cards.comment: TV24 offer The Perfect Band its own weekly TV-show: Friday night prime-time with satellite distribution all over the world.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: TV24 Offer TV Show
cards.question: Take the offer?

cards.comment: The Perfect Band has its own worldwide television show. 95% of the world's population watched the pilot and all other TV stations cancelled their broadcast for the duration of the program.
cards.name: TV
cards.Headline: The Perfect TV Show
cards.question: Like, ninety-five per cent?

cards.comment: The cabinet have appointed Billy "Alba" Watt their new youth minister.\n\tHis strong political commitment and his integrity to turn down the offer for his own TV-show are the reasons given for the appointment.\n\tBilly is overjoyed and plans to change the establishment from the inside-out.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Alba Appointed Youth Minister
cards.question: Who would have guessed?

cards.comment: The Global Corporation opens a theme park, Perfect-World, entirely dedicated to The Perfect Band. It's an instant success.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: The Perfect Theme Park
cards.question: The kids love it

cards.comment: A civil war has broken out in a third world country and in spite of the United Nations negotiation efforts, there is no peace in sight.\n\tNow the secretary general turns to The Perfect Band for assistance.\n\tIf they do a concert in the country, maybe there can finally be peace.
cards.name: Business
cards.Headline: United Nations Call for Perfect Assistance
cards.question: Do the gig?

cards.comment: The peace concert had an immediate beneficial effect.\n\tHalfway throughout the gig, the armed forces agreed on a cease fire and the peace treaty will be signed within a few days.\n\tThe UN enter the Right to Perfect Music into the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, so that no human being shall want for The Perfect Song.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: Concert Gives Peace
cards.question: That's something, isn't it?

cards.comment: The Nobel Committee have instituted a new Nobel Prize for Music.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: TPB Get Nobel Prize
cards.question: Guess who'll get it?

cards.comment: The Perfect Band declare their intention to do the first concert ever in outer space.\n\tThe Global Space Division has been working on it for a while, and soon they will be ready to send your band into orbit.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: Another Original Concept
cards.question: Perfect Band in outer space

cards.comment: The Perfect Band do the first ever concert in outer space.\n\tPlaying in an orbiting capsule, their music reaches every corner of the globe.
cards.name: Concert
cards.Headline: First Concert in Space
cards.question: The sky used to be the limit

cards.comment: Global kingpin G. Jerome Vonderbaldt is steaming mad at you for trying to change TPB's name.\n\tHe immediately changes it back.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Don't change the Perfect Name
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Quit messing about!

cards.comment: You don't think that The Perfect Band should play The Perfect Song?\n\tFine. It should, however, come as no surprise that Global has a different opinion.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Don't change the Perfect Song
cards.Caption: G. Jerome Vonderbaldt, S.S.O.P. Global Records
cards.question: Do like he says

cards.comment: Hey! The Perfect Band is Global Records' creature, so don't you try anything.\n\tYou're a nobody! You're just the errand boy for this job. You are more replaceable than any of the band members.\n\tSorry, but you're out.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: You're Fired
cards.Caption: You should have listened
cards.question: Game over

cards.comment: Let's settle this once and for all: YOU'RE NOT SUPPOSED TO CHANGE THE PERFECT BAND!
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Okay, start over and next time try to record The Perfect Song.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: Try again and stay with Global.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: The Global boss is furious that you won't let The Perfect Band appear on the cover of The Perfect Song in their Perfect Stage Costumes.\n\tHe will let this mistake slide, but you should be warned of such negligence.
cards.name: Record Company
cards.Headline: Global Want Perfect Sleeve
cards.question: Got it?

cards.comment: Your funds are limited so spend them carefully.
cards.name: Info

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> is fed up with playing in this band. {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} says that if things don't change soon, {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} will quit.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Threatens to Quit
cards.question: Problems in the band

cards.comment: <¤CRealMusician.name> can't take it anymore. Now {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]}'s leaving the band.
cards.name: Artist
cards.Headline: <¤CRealMusician.name> Quits
cards.question: {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} took off
